description: Intent classification schema for the Universal AI Agent Plugin (Shopify build). Each user message is classified into exactly one intent AND one action of that intent. Every action carries its own description, entities and example utterances so similar actions can be told apart.

intents.name: registration_login
intents.description: User wants to create an account, sign in, sign out, or recover access.

actions.name: register
actions.description: Create a new account.
example_utterances: I want to create an account

actions.name: login
actions.description: Sign in to an existing account.

actions.name: logout
actions.description: Sign out of the account.

actions.name: forgot_password
actions.description: Recover access when the password is forgotten.

example_utterances: I want to create an account

intents.name: order_tracking
intents.description: User wants the status of one order or a list of their orders. Logged-in shoppers need no order number or email, guests can provide email or order number.

actions.name: track_order
actions.description: Where is ONE specific order, its delivery status, tracking number, carrier status, checkpoints or ETA. Use this for 'where is my order' / 'track package' questions.
example_utterances: What is the status of order 1001

actions.name: list_recent_orders
actions.description: Show a list of ALL the shopper's orders (all, past, current, active or pending) or their order history, not the status of one specific order.
example_utterances: Show all my past and current orders

intents.name: cart_management
intents.description: User wants to view, add, remove, edit, or clear the contents of their shopping cart directly from messages.

actions.name: add_item
actions.description: Add a product or variant directly to the cart.
example_utterances: Add 2 blue shirts to my cart
I want to buy the linen tote

actions.name: add_all_to_cart
actions.description: Add ALL products from the store to the cart at once. Use this when the shopper explicitly asks to add every product, all items, or the entire catalog to their cart. Do NOT use this for adding a single named product.
example_utterances: Add all products to my cart
Add everything in the store to my cart
Put all items in my cart
Add the whole catalog to my cart

actions.name: remove_item
actions.description: Remove a product or a specific quantity of a product directly from the cart. If quantity is specified (e.g. 'remove 1 unit of liquid'), remove that many units. If no quantity is specified, remove all units of that product.
example_utterances: Remove the blue shirt from my cart
Remove 1 unit of liquid from my cart
Take 1 hoodie out of my cart

actions.name: edit_quantity
actions.description: Update or change the quantity of a product directly in the cart.
example_utterances: Change the quantity of shirt to 2

actions.name: view_cart
actions.description: Show what is currently in the cart with items, quantities, prices, and total.

actions.name: clear_cart
actions.description: Remove EVERYTHING from the cart and empty it.

example_utterances: Add 2 blue shirts to my cart
I want to buy the linen tote
Remove the blue shirt from my cart
Delete the mug from my cart

intents.name: warranty_claim
intents.description: User wants to file or check a warranty, replacement, or return claim for a purchased item.

actions.name: submit_claim
actions.description: File a warranty or replacement claim for a damaged, defective, or incorrect product from an order.
example_utterances: I want to claim warranty for order #1001
This product arrived broken, I want a warranty replacement
File a warranty claim, the headphones stopped working
My jacket zipper broke, claim warranty
I received a damaged item in order 1042, need warranty claim

actions.name: check_claim_status
actions.description: Check the review progress or approval status of a previously filed warranty or return claim.
example_utterances: What's the status of my warranty claim?
Has my warranty return been approved?
Any update on my warranty claim?
I want to claim warranty for order #1001
This product arrived broken, I want a replacement
File a warranty claim, the zip is faulty
What's the status of my warranty claim?

intents.name: payment_checkout
intents.description: User wants to save payment credentials, initiate checkout and payment, or provide the OTP in the chat to pay for their order.

actions.name: save_payment_credentials
actions.description: Save or update customer payment credentials (cardholder name, card number, expiry date, CVV, billing address) for 1-click checkout.
example_utterances: Save card ending in 4242 for checkout

actions.name: initiate_payment
actions.description: Proceed to checkout and initiate payment for items in cart using stored credentials, triggering an OTP challenge.
example_utterances: I want to checkout and pay
Proceed to payment with saved card
Buy items in my cart now

actions.name: confirm_payment_otp
actions.description: Provide the 6-digit OTP code in chat to authenticate and complete the payment.

intents.name: product_search
intents.description: User wants to find products or get product suggestions.

actions.name: search_products
actions.description: Find products by name, category or attributes, optionally filtered by price, color or size.
example_utterances: Do you have this in blue?

actions.name: get_recommendations
actions.description: Suggest products PERSONALLY for this shopper (based on their orders and searches), without naming what they want. May carry a budget or category.

example_utterances: Do you have this in blue?

intents.name: policy_query
intents.description: User is asking about store policies (refund, returns, shipping, warranty, privacy, terms, cancellation).

actions.name: answer_policy_question
actions.description: Answer a question about a store policy.
example_utterances: Do you have a warranty policy?
Do you sell my data to anyone?
Do you sell my data to anyone?

intents.name: general_chat
intents.description: User greets the assistant, asks what the store sells, asks about assistant capabilities, or engages in casual shopping conversation.

actions.name: assistant_help
actions.description: Welcome the shopper, explain what the assistant can do (browse products, update cart, track orders, warranty claims, policy checks, OTP checkout), and invite them to explore.

actions.name: recommend_products
actions.description: Show trending or featured products when shopper asks for general suggestions without naming a specific product.

intents.name: fallback
intents.description: Message doesn't clearly match any defined intent, or confidence is too low to act on. Agent should ask a clarifying question rather than guess.

actions.name: clarify
actions.description: Ask the shopper what they mean.
example_utterances: can you help me with something
can you help me with something

classification_output_format.intent: one of the intent names above
classification_output_format.action: one of that intent's action names
classification_output_format.entities: key-value object of any entities extracted from the message, kept in the language the user wrote them in
classification_output_format.requires_confirmation: boolean, copied from the matched action definition
classification_output_format.language: ISO 639-1 code of the language the user's message was written or spoken in, e.g. 'en', 'hi', 'pa', 'es', 'fr', 'ar'

below_threshold_behavior: route to fallback.clarify instead of guessing
